title: Full Stack Development
description: Master JavaScript for the web, from manipulating page elements and handling events to creating dynamic, interactive websites with persistent data, all through hands-on projects.
outcomes: Master foundational to advanced concepts in Web development using JavaScript Mastery
Solve real-world coding problems with optimized time and space complexity
Build industry-ready projects and pass dual 90% gateway assessments

series.title: Foundation
series.description: Essential building blocks, core theory, environment setup.

series.title: Core
series.description: Primary syntax, core data structures, algorithms, and key patterns.

series.title: Advanced
series.description: Complex algorithms, architectural trade-offs, high performance.

series.title: Expert
series.description: Industry engineering, system scaling, production grade mastery.

modules.title: Working with the DOM
modules.description: Learn to see your HTML not just as code, but as a dynamic object you can inspect, select, and instantly manipulate to control every element on the page.

modules.title: Making Websites Interactive (Events)
modules.description: Master the event system to listen for user actions—like clicks, submits, and keypresses—and trigger JavaScript functions that make your website truly responsive.

modules.title: Creating & Managing Elements
modules.description: Discover how to programmatically generate, insert, and destroy HTML, allowing you to create dynamic lists, feeds, and interfaces that update without a page refresh.

modules.title: Working with localStorage
modules.description: Unlock the power of browser storage to save user data, preferences, and application states, ensuring a persistent and seamless experience across visits.

modules.title: Mini Project
modules.description: Apply your full skill set—from DOM manipulation and event handling to data persistence—by building a complete, functional web application from scratch.
